sources.title: Shenzhen operator reports current LineShine HPC and AI applications
sources.publisher: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.attribution: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.summary: The operator currently reports more than ten HPC and AI applications on LineShine, alongside accomplished scientific computations. This supports existing system operations; June TOP500 results and undated record computations are not redated as September milestones.
sources.date_semantics: September 14 is the dated report of current application use, not opening, commissioning, full capacity delivery or original experiment date.

sources.title: Shenzhen operator reports September 16 visit to Phase 2 and LineShine
sources.publisher: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.attribution: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.summary: The September 17 report names the September 16 visit to Phase 2 application demonstrations and LineShine. Physical host identity and corroborating context only; a visit by itself is not the selected operational evidence.
sources.date_semantics: Published September 17; visit September 16. No operational date derived solely from the visit.

sources.title: Shenzhen operator distinguishes Xili Phase 1 from Guangming Phase 2
sources.publisher: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.attribution: National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen (Shenzhen Cloud Computing Center)
sources.summary: Operator overview explicitly places Phase 2 in the Guangming Science City major-science-facility core, identifies LineShine there and gives the 116800-square-metre complex area. Phase 1 is separately in Xili; the generic Nanshan footer is not the Phase 2 location.
sources.date_semantics: Spatial or identity context only. Retrieval is not a lifecycle observation.

sources.title: Municipal notice for Guangming major-science cluster plot 01-06
sources.publisher: Shenzhen Science Technology and Innovation authority; notice by Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau Guangming office
sources.attribution: Shenzhen Science Technology and Innovation authority; notice by Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau Guangming office
sources.summary: Municipal page attaches the plot 01-06 locator and identifies its 45994.25-square-metre land east of Longda Expressway. Page publication is March 18 2022 while notice body and consultation dates are March 18-April 17 2021. The mismatch is preserved; no current permit or status is inferred.
sources.date_semantics: Page published 2022-03-18; underlying notice signed 2021-03-18; consultation 2021-03-18 to 2021-04-17. Historical geometry context only.

sources.title: Municipal plot 01-06 satellite location and site-selection plan
sources.publisher: Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau Guangming office, hosted by Shenzhen Science Technology and Innovation authority
sources.attribution: Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau Guangming office, hosted by Shenzhen Science Technology and Innovation authority
sources.summary: One-page official plan labels the trapezoidal plot 01-06 immediately east of Longda Expressway, north of its loop junction, opposite the warehouse compound and south of a highway crossing. Parcel overlay is matched to captured WGS84 imagery for an interior parent-campus point. No surveyed boundary is digitized.
sources.date_semantics: Undated attachment to notice signed 2021-03-18 on page published 2022-03-18. Satellite acquisition date and source-map positional accuracy unknown.

sources.title: Shenzhen GM-2023-0020 permit connects the named supercomputing upgrade to plot 01-06
sources.publisher: Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources authority
sources.attribution: Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources authority
sources.summary: Official one-page permit identifies the named National Supercomputing Shenzhen Center upgrade project at Guangming plot 01-06, parcel A649-0643. Historical property identity only; no present permit, ownership or lifecycle assertion. Content hash pins the exact serialized web-tool text extraction, not original PDF response bytes. Direct raw capture failed TLS BAD_ECPOINT and was not bypassed.
sources.date_semantics: Permit dated June 6, 2023. Historical project-to-parcel identity; current operating status comes from the separate September 14, 2026 operator report.
sources.capture_limit: Direct urllib request failed TLS BAD_ECPOINT; no retry or TLS bypass. Web service independently returned readable one-page official permit. Hash pins the exact serialized tool response, not PDF bytes.

review_notes: Eleven original response captures including two exact canonical Esri reuse objects, plus one explicitly labelled serialized web-tool extraction of the official permit. No original PDF hash is claimed for the extraction. Source bodies remain local.
